name: Through the Ages: A New Story of Civilization

categories.label: Culture points (culture track, at game end)
categories.labelVi: Điểm văn hóa (trên track khi kết thúc)
categories.hint: Read the culture track after the last round; culture is scored continuously during play.

categories.label: Culture from Age III events evaluated at game end
categories.labelVi: Điểm văn hóa từ sự kiện Age III lúc kết thúc
categories.hint: Evaluate all Age III events in the current and next events decks; add culture gained (negative if lost).

categories.label: Other end-of-game bonuses
categories.hint: Any end-of-game bonuses printed on cards in play.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players share the victory.

winCondition: Most culture points after the final round and final scoring wins. Game also ends immediately if only one player remains after a player is eliminated by a war/aggression loss.

endCondition.description: Normally ends when Age III ends (last round completed so all players have equal turns); ends early if only one player is left in the game, who wins.

notes: family: running-track-plus-events. Culture is tracked on the board during play; final scoring adds Age III events and end-of-game card bonuses. Starting-player counts as current player for tie resolution in end-game events. Solo/team variants not covered.

sources.title: Through the Ages: A New Story of Civilization rulebook (Czech Games Edition)
sources.section: p.1 Game Flow (final scoring); Evaluating an Event; card glossary (Bill Gates)
